themes_detail.label: Door/Window Damage Spike
themes_detail.summary: Door and window complaints have surged to 7 THIS WEEK, a 1300% spike from the 0.5 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, suggesting either weather-related damage, break-ins, or building code violations affecting multiple properties in South Beach/Dongan Hills.
evidence: 7 door/window complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (z-score: 9.19)
1300% increase represents largest percentage spike in current dataset
Spike is immediate and concentrated in single week, suggesting acute event or condition
reporting_angles: Are residents experiencing break-ins, weather damage, or structural issues? Interview affected homeowners.
Check NYPD crime data for burglaries or property crimes spiking concurrently in CD 502.

themes_detail.label: Special Projects Inspection Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Special Projects Inspection Team (SPIT) complaints jumped to 3 THIS WEEK from a 0.2 weekly average, a 1100% spike (z-score: 6.35), indicating potential code enforcement or inspection disputes affecting residents.
evidence: 3 SPIT complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 6.35)
Timing coincides with door/window spike, potentially related to inspections
SPIT typically handles enforcement of City Building Code; complaints suggest resident friction with inspectors
reporting_angles: What triggered SPIT activity in South Beach this week? Check DOB permit and violation records.
Are residents complaining about aggressive inspections, fines, or citations? Request SPIT case files.

themes_detail.label: Elevator Maintenance Issues
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints surged to 5 LAST WEEK from a 0.5 weekly average, a 900% spike (z-score: 9.0), affecting multi-unit residential or commercial buildings and potentially trapping residents.
evidence: 5 elevator complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (z-score: 9.0)
Affects access for elderly and disabled residents; public safety concern
reporting_angles: Which buildings in South Beach have non-functioning elevators? Interview residents about wait times and impacts.
Check NYC Department of Buildings elevator inspection records for recent violations or failed inspections.

themes_detail.label: Building Maintenance and Facility Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Maintenance and facility complaints jumped to 13 LAST WEEK from a 2.0 weekly average, a 550% spike (z-score: 15.56), indicating widespread deterioration of building systems or infrastructure across the district.
evidence: 13 maintenance/facility complaints LAST WEEK vs. 2.0 weekly average (z-score: 15.56, severity: high)
Spike complements elevator and door/window complaints, suggesting broader building system failures
Community board budget requests repeatedly cite 'other park maintenance and safety' and 'DSNY expense requests,' implying chronic maintenance backlog
reporting_angles: Survey multiple buildings in South Beach to document maintenance issues: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing.
Interview residents and building managers about deferred maintenance and repair timelines; cross-reference with DOB violation data.

themes_detail.label: Consumer Complaints Surge (3 weeks ago)
themes_detail.summary: Consumer complaints peaked at 14 THREE WEEKS AGO, a 300% spike from the 3.5 weekly average (z-score: 7.42), potentially indicating fraud, service disputes, or predatory business practices affecting South Beach residents.
evidence: 14 consumer complaints THREE WEEKS AGO vs. 3.5 weekly baseline (z-score: 7.42)
Timing is older than current week spikes but still statistically significant
Complaint type is vague; requires investigation to identify specific sector or business category
reporting_angles: Request detailed complaint descriptions from 311 database to identify common scams, contractors, or service providers.
Check NYC Department of Consumer Affairs enforcement actions and civil court filings in South Beach for patterns.
